expected_behavior: runs the bundled QA script to produce a bounded contact sheet, phone-width first/mid/last stills, a safe-zone overlay and a luminance-jump report

opens and looks at the images rather than trusting the script, and checks each item of the review checklist (poster frame, text inside safe area, readable at phone width, nothing under the bottom band, CTA still, no strobing)
reports pass, fail or manual-required per check with frame numbers for anything to fix, and routes fixes to the right skill (layout, motion, export)
does not declare the video done if any check is failed or unverified

cases.prompt: The 8 s loop gif for the deck: check the seam and the flicker someone noticed.
expected_behavior: renders the wrap strip (last frames followed by first frames) and inspects continuity of pose
reads the luminance-jump report and distinguishes intended cuts from flashes, reporting the frames
recommends the motion skill for a seam or flicker fix, not a re-encode
